rules.statement: An action to recover purchase money, which is expressed in the conveyance to have been previously paid, is prescribed within three years under section 8 of the Prescription Ordinance No. 22 of 1871.
rules.supporting_quote: "If so, he must be suing upon an unwritten one and if so, is within section 8 of the Ordinance which means that his action not having been brought within the three years is prescribed."
